posts.title: NASA Opens 2027 Human Lander Challenge for Lunar Communications
posts.lead: NASA’s 2027 Human Lander Challenge is seeking ideas from college and university students to help address one of the most critical needs for sustained lunar exploration: reliable communications.

posts.title: 14 lot Starshipa. Pierwsza podróż na orbitę
